title: Hospital emergency
description: A family member is in the emergency room or intensive care. The pastor takes the call and needs a case summary, an information brief, hospital resources, a checklist, and a pastoral message.

disclaimer.en: Nury is an AI assistant, not a doctor, nurse, lawyer, pastor, counselor, or therapist. This is general information, not medical or legal advice. Please ask the hospital care team about the patient.
disclaimer.es: Nury es un asistente de IA, no es médico, enfermero, abogado, pastor, consejero ni terapeuta. Esto es información general, no es asesoramiento médico ni legal. Por favor pregunte al equipo del hospital sobre el paciente.

draft_label.es: Borrador de Nury para revisión del pastor

intake.placeholder: Who called, who is in the hospital, which hospital and unit, when, and what the family asks.
intake.demo: Rosa called at 11:10 PM, upset, speaking Spanish. Her father Miguel, 68, was taken by ambulance to the emergency room of a hospital in Aurora this evening. The staff would not tell her anything on the phone. Her mother is with her, and her two children, 6 and 9, are with a neighbor. She wants to know what she can ask the hospital tonight.
